summary: The article provides a generally accurate preview of Intel's Q2 2026 earnings, aligning well with analyst expectations and Intel's own guidance from Q1 2026. However, it incorrectly identifies the CEO.

claims.claim: Intel is set to announce its Q2 2026 earnings after market close on July 23, 2026, with analysts expecting modest profitability and revenue growth.
claims.note: Intel officially announced it would report Q2 2026 financial results on Thursday, July 23, 2026, after market close.

claims.claim: Consensus estimates project revenue around $14.42 billion and non-GAAP earnings per share (EPS) of $0.21-$0.22.
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm consensus analyst estimates for Q2 2026 revenue around $14.42 billion and non-GAAP EPS of $0.21-$0.22.

claims.claim: Management had guided for Q2 revenue between $13.8 billion and $14.8 billion, and non-GAAP EPS of $0.20.
claims.note: Intel's Q1 2026 earnings report included guidance for Q2 2026 revenue between $13.8 billion and $14.8 billion, and non-GAAP diluted EPS of $0.20.

claims.claim: In Q1 2026, Intel reported a robust non-GAAP EPS of $0.29 on revenue of $13.6 billion, both well ahead of analyst expectations.
claims.note: Intel's Q1 2026 results showed revenue of $13.6 billion and non-GAAP EPS of $0.29, exceeding analyst estimates.

claims.claim: Gross margins are expected to be a key focus, with management guiding for approximately 39% for Q2, a slight dip from Q1.
claims.note: Intel's Q1 2026 earnings call and reports confirm management guided for a Q2 non-GAAP gross margin of approximately 39%, down from 41% in Q1 2026.

claims.claim: CEO Lip-Bu Tan's commentary on the "sixth consecutive quarter of revenue above expectations" and the ongoing turnaround strategy will be closely scrutinised.
claims.note: The current CEO of Intel is Pat Gelsinger. Lip-Bu Tan is mentioned in some search results as CEO, but this appears to be an error in those sources, as Intel's official investor relations and newsroom consistently name Pat Gelsinger as CEO.

claims.claim: In Q1 2026, Intel Foundry revenue grew 16% year-over-year to $5.4 billion.
claims.note: Intel's Q1 2026 earnings reports confirm Intel Foundry revenue was $5.4 billion, up 16% year-over-year.

article_title: Intel (INTC) Stock Q2 2026 Earnings Preview: What to Expect
